title: Theo and the Letter
author: A. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Okafor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
